name: bulk_comment_delete
description: Bulk-deletes comments grouped by the content type of the commented node, via a confirm form and batch.
project_description:
This module allow to delete all comments and replies according to content type selection.

Installation

 
 Copy the whole "Bulk Comment Delete" directory to your modules 
 Enable the module. 
 Select required options in the form to suit your needs. 
 
 Features

 This module allow to delete all comments and replies according to content type selection.

 Documentation

 README.txt For everyone

 Goals

Delete all comments and replies according to content type selection.

 Warning

 This is a very powerful tool that operates directly on your database tables, and as such is very dangerous. we highly encourage you to backup your database before using it.
